args.sql:
SELECT 
    e.equipmenttype AS Equipment, 
    ww.waterqualityindex AS "Water Quality Index", 
    ww.waterlevelpercent AS "Water Level Percentage", 
    om.operationalstatus AS "Status Category",
    (ww.waterqualityindex * ww.waterlevelpercent) AS "Water Management Score"
FROM 
    waterandwaste ww
JOIN 
    equipment e ON ww.watereqref = e.equipmentcode
JOIN 
    operationmaintenance om ON e.equipmentcode = om.opmainteqref;
